allow.Dockerfile.local-dev: Local-dev container build for binject/binpress with LIEF from source, matching the Depot AlmaLinux 8 configuration; its docker build context is the repo root, so the file is root-anchored.
allow.vendor: Vendored third-party trees (acorn-wasm). 'vendor' is the conventional root name the native-source doctrine skips by name, so relocating it would re-expose vendored code to fleet doctrine.
allow.xport.json: The feature-parity ports manifest — the source of truth for upstream pins that package docs cite as ../../xport.json, so the path is part of its contract.
